summary: The second remediation closes the three operational defects identified by the allowed prior code FAIL: the live source reconstruction now checks the frozen PR-152 byte pins and raw-record root, failed/incomplete/unsigned deep-replay receipts are rejected, and the recorded result command reproduces from a sanitized environment. All five current result-bearing artifacts retain exact 40 < L < 763 support and conditional C3, public_use=false, transfer_source=none claim metadata; no affirmative raw-QE, detection, isotropy, physical attribution, transfer/native, geometry, or family promotion was found. Closeout nevertheless remains blocked. The final validator accepts a resealed authoritative replay whose PR-152 release-card input_hash is false, and also accepts a coordinated reseal of the feature-card and replay PR-152 input_hashes plus their mutual bindings. The independent frozen input_authentication remains correct, so the present computation is source-rooted, but the required provenance metadata can contradict that authority without rejection. The PR delta is also stale at 23 mutations and 13 tests while the sealed pack has 28 mutations and the current targeted lane has 15 tests.

final_claim_findings.title: PR-152 provenance input hashes can contradict the frozen authority and still pass the final validator
final_claim_findings.statement: The second remediation correctly authenticates the live PR-152 small authorities and independently reconstructed raw-record root through source_authority_errors and input_authentication. It does not require the duplicate PR-152 and embedded-source entries in the feature card's required input_hashes metadata or the authoritative deep-replay receipt's input_hashes metadata to equal those frozen values. A resealed deep replay with docs/generated/act_raw_qe_card.json changed to 64 zeroes passes _deep_replay_errors and the complete validate_feature_card path with errors=[]. A coordinated reseal that changes the same PR-152 input_hash in both the feature card and replay, then updates the feature-card hash, semantic digest, and replay outer digest, also passes with errors=[]. Current on-disk values are correct, but the acceptance gate permits contradictory source provenance.
